definitions.explanation: A word or words by which a person, place, or thing is known. Includes both given names and family names.

examples.japanese: お{名前|なまえ}は{何|なん}ですか？
examples.notes: お名前 is the polite form

examples.japanese: ここに{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
この{花|はな}の{名前|なまえ}を{知|し}っていますか？
examples.english: Do you know the name of this flower?

notes:
A fundamental noun. Can be made polite with お: お{名前|なまえ}.

Related:
- {名字|みょうじ}/{苗字|みょうじ} (family name)
- {下|した}の{名前|なまえ} (first name).
